source_reading_scope: Existing GWTC4 TGR III PDF pp1,3,4,5,6,7, table1 O4a rows and table2 IMR columns/caption; not whole paper. No new downloads or posterior access.
source_convention: Table1 takes binary parameters from each run catalog; table2 overlap proves exact equality of Mf_det/chi_f and errors with explicitly labeled GR full-IMR medians. Physical baseline is GR; pre-deformation does not mean inspiral-only or independent data.
scope_caveats: Snapshot GWOSC metadata from E0; no update of SNR or catalog versions in this adendum
Old GWTC4.0 TGR baseline values joined to E0 preferred GWOSC versions; no claim that these are newly recomputed medians for GWTC4.1
Some old TGR SNRs are below12 even when preferred GWOSC total is >=12; keep chosen GWOSC convention
Missing old-table rows remain awaiting, including single-detector event excluded by paper; absence is not physics failure
No fuzzy event-name matching; similarly dated events distinct
Eligibility uses medians by adopted INPUT, not credible-bound or posterior-width cuts
No table of deformation posteriors read for new test events
